text: The air is formless and touch-bearing. It is of two kinds, eternal and non-eternal. The eternal is in the form of atoms; the non-eternal is in the form of its effects. Again, it is of three kinds due to the difference between body and senses. The body is in the realm of air; the sense is the skin, which perceives touch and pervades the entire body. The object is the cause of the movement of trees and other things. || 12 ||
